title: MV Issue with d20 skill based checks in RPG Maker MV using Frogboy's Talent_Core plugin

posts.author: DunginsAndDaggins
posts.body: I desperately want the dice roll mechanic to work and I'm not even entirely sure why it's not. I want an Insight roll of 14 or greater to trigger the first part of the conditional branch and a failure to trigger the else path which switches the event page to page 3 controlled by Switch B being activated upon choosing to not perform the Talent Check or failure of the Talent Check. page 3 locks you out of attempting it again and makes the NPC disappear. I have been working on this all day(purely to test mechanics) and am not any closer to understanding why the result of the Talent Check seems to have zero effect on which path is chosen. I really don't want to disappoint my partner, she is really excited at the idea of d20 checks in this game and we want to try to simulate a TTRPG experience where things like permanently failing are just as much a part of the game as succeeding.

posts.author: doller554
posts.body:
D 20 Roll is easy. Set up a variable and random it from 1 to 20. Now take that variable and set up a Conditional Branch to only work if that variable is 14 or greater it works, Else, it fails.

posts.author: Another Fen
posts.body:
Hey,
If you want to keep using Frogboys plugin, my first guess would be to try to add
var:18
to the plugin command parameters (replace 18 with the variable ID).
I have not confirmed what the plugin does if you don't specify a variable, so maybe that one is not the problem here.
